entries.en: behind the eyes; after the eyes
entries.notes: 西语词头存在 Depre/Sepre 判读疑点，释义以汉字『目后』及 M、R 两栏对音互证为据。

entries.en: behind; at the back (of a thing)
entries.notes: R 栏有 hēn/kēn 判读疑点，但西语 detrás de la cosa 与汉字『後壁』及 M 栏三栏一致，释义不受影响。

entries.zh: 凑足还清（债务）；凑齐债款
entries.en: debt paid off/settled; to make up money to clear a debt
entries.notes: 汉字栏有 湊/淨 判读疑点，取『湊』与 M 栏对音相符，释义为凑齐款项偿清债务。

entries.zh: 给债主；付给主人（责令偿还之债）
entries.en: debt ordered to be paid; to give/pay to the creditor

entries.en: same; of the same (house, year, family, etc.)
of the same boat; in the same boatload
entries.notes: 西语词头有 Barcada/Aarcada 判读疑点，取 Barcada（船载）与汉字『同舡』相符。

entries.en: of one heart; of the same mind, unanimous
of one mind; in accord, united in heart
of the same time; contemporaneous, same age
of the same year; of the same age
